title: PromptOps: Iterative Prompt Optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.07123v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for evaluating the behavior of chatbots and other AI systems. In deployment, however, their agreement with the intended human evaluation policy may degrade as user interactions and score distributions change. Existing automatic prompt optimization methods are primarily studied as one-shot procedures on static development sets and therefore provide limited guidance for maintaining LLM judges over time. We frame this problem as judge drift and introduce PromptOps, a closedloop framework for monitoring and iteratively recalibrating LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaaJ) systems. PromptOps separates four operational decisions: when to optimize, which optimization procedure to apply, which feedback records to use, and how to update the judge prompt. translated_title: PromptOps：面向LLM-as-a-Judge系统的迭代式提示词优化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作自动化评判器，用于评估聊天机器人和其他AI系统的行为。然而在部署过程中，随着用户交互和评分分布的变化，它们与预期人工评估策略的一致性可能会下降。现有的自动提示词优化方法主要被作为在静态开发集上的一次性流程来研究，因此对于长期维护LLM评判器提供的指导有限。我们将这一问题定义为“评判器漂移”，并提出了PromptOps——一个用于监控和迭代重新校准LLM-as-a-Judge（LLMaaJ）系统的闭环框架。PromptOps将四个运营决策分离开来：何时进行优化、应用哪种优化流程、使用哪些反馈记录、以及如何更新评判器提示词。我们用五种提示词优化方法对该框架进行了实例化：GEPA、SIMBA、评分标准合成，以及使用……的示例选择方法。
tldr: 本文提出PromptOps闭环框架，将LLM评判器在部署中与人工评估策略一致性下降的问题定义为“评判器漂移”，通过分离何时优化、应用何种优化流程、选用哪些反馈记录及如何更新提示词这四个运营决策，实现LLM-as-a-Judge系统的持续监控与迭代重新校准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PromptOps, a closed-loop framework that addresses "judge drift" in deployed LLM-as-a-Judge systems by separating four operational decisions—when to optimize, which optimization procedure to apply, which feedback records to use, and how to update the judge prompt—enabling continuous monitoring and iterative recalibration.
